Semantic intents 1

1⚠️ Remove special NFS item contracts from 2026-12-06 1 model properties

The change removes symbolic-link, block-device, character-device, FIFO, and socket item models, their XML collections, related NFS metadata, and special-file values. Directory listing and file creation retain their routes but lose nested response elements and accepted type values.

API surface: Three model properties are added. Operations using those models expose the new fields, but the 2-operation version-lineage inventory is not a direct-impact count.

ChangeAspectBeforeAfterImpact
✏️ Modified special NFS request and response surface The 2026-12-06 API included special-file values, item models, XML collections, and related metadata. Those values, models, collections, and metadata are removed from the same API version.
Operation parameter contract changesOperation response contract changesOperation parameter contract changesREST contract changes require generated-client updatesExisting versioned API surface is removed

TypeSpec change: The change removes symbolic-link, block-device, character-device, FIFO, and socket item models, their XML collections, related NFS metadata, and special-file values. Directory listing and file creation retain their routes but lose nested response elements and accepted type values.

Operation impact: operations using the changed models expose the additive fields in their payload schemas. The broader 2-operation API-version lineage is summarized here rather than presented as 2 direct behavioral changes.
